modelDescription: The Steiner M750rc Reticle & Compass 7x50 for when tactical operations take place in challenging conditions these are the optics to count on. Proven on missions from extreme darkness to high-altitude sun, arctic cold to desert heat, they give you exactly the optical capabilities you need: mid-90% light transmission, image clarity from edge to edge, even integrated compass, range-finding or custom reticles and laser protection if desired. Integrates bright image, illuminated HD stabilized compass and range finding reticle, giving you the ability to accurately identify targets and determine bearings and distance to the single degree. Features floating Prism System, Sports-Auto Focus System, N2 Injection system, cylindrical eyecups, NBR Rubber Armoring, Makrolon housing and a Ranging Reticle: a versatile ranging reticle found on all "r" models that be used to judge both the height and distance to a target. Includes neck strap, objective cover and a rain protection cap.
